### 17:37Z - Routing and design evidence implemented locally

- One dossier selection now drives routing and reserves exposure in the
  compiler's niche. Explicit fixed renderers skip the dossier library.
  A typed shortage can fall back; a missing core registry entry, invalid
  dossier, or unsupported kind still fails closed.
- A completed reservation event now requires evidence of a history
  reservation. The preview design receipt distinguishes requested and
  rendered design, binds authored candidates to their actual dossier,
  and compares the built homepage digest with the existing live readback.
  Protected diagnostics identify build evidence without claiming delivery.
- The independent review caught a real pack fingerprint rejected by the
  initial validator, a missing-core-record downgrade path, a mismatched
  rotation key, stale live readback, and an omitted diagnostic receipt.
  All five were addressed; a saved Astro pack homepage now generates the
  expected receipt with no dossier attribution or client content.
- Admin and production builds passed. The first full suite was interrupted
  by the server restart. Final focused regression run: 262 passed, 2 skipped
  across 12 files. Full-suite rerun in progress; keep the worktree and branch
  until verification and integration finish. No deployment or live
